meta.name: config-explorer
meta.description: Inspect and safely edit the Claude Code and Codex configuration surfaces exposed by CCAM. Use when auditing skills, agents, commands, plugins, marketplaces, MCP servers, hooks, settings, memory, keybindings, profiles, rules, or instruction files, and when a backup-backed allowlisted edit is required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安全查看并调整 AI 编码助手的各项配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要调整 AI 编码助手的行为设置并担心改错。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect and safely edit AI coding assistant configurations with backup support.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to audit and safely modify AI coding assistant settings with backup protection.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可检查并安全修改 Claude Code 与 Codex 配置。能读取技能、MCP、钩子、记忆等，写入文本与键绑定，每次写入或删除均会生成带时间戳的备份。
howto.when: 当你要查看或修改配置，比如检查技能、代理、MCP 服务器等，或需要带备份的安全编辑时触发。

say.text: 查看我的 Claude Code 技能配置。
修改我的键绑定，记得先备份。
say.note: 先备份再安全修改键绑定。

say.text: 查看 Codex 的配置概览。
say.note: 显示 Codex 配置摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can inspect and safely edit Claude Code and Codex configuration. It reads skills, MCP, hooks, memory, etc., writes text artifacts and keybindings, and creates timestamped backups for every write or delete.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request viewing or editing configuration, such as auditing skills, agents, MCP servers, etc., or requiring backup-backed safe edits.

say_en.text: Show my Claude Code skills configuration.
Modify my keybindings with a backup.
say_en.note: Creates a backup then edits keybindings.
Executes codex overview for a summary.
